notes.title: Vasrak Kingdom: Battle on the Frontier - DEMO ON STEAM!
notes.notes:
[h2]Demo Version Released![/h2]  
We are thrilled to announce the release of the demo version of [b]Vasrak Kingdom: Battle on the Frontier[/b].  
We’ll be improving the game further based on feedback from our players!  

[h3]What is Vasrak Kingdom: Battle on the Frontier?[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] [b]A unique blend of deck-building and Tic-Tac-Toe[/b]: Summon and position soldiers to capture lines and defeat your enemies.  
[*] [b]Real-time strategy[/b]: Make quick decisions in a dynamic battlefield to achieve victory.  
[*] [b]Story and worldbuilding[/b]: Dive into a world of resource wars featuring adorable hamster characters!  
[/list]  

[h3]What’s included in the demo?[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Learn the basics of the game through an early combat tutorial.  
[*] Test your strategies in battles using a variety of soldier cards.  
[*] Some features will be added in the full version!  
[/list]  

[h3]What’s next?[/h3]  
The full version will include more cards, units, an expanded story, and new features. Your feedback from the demo will help us make the game even better!  

[h3]We need your feedback![/h3]  
After playing the demo, please send us your thoughts or suggestions via email.  
[b]Email[/b]: vasrakgames@gmail.com  

Your valuable feedback is a huge help in improving the game.  
Download the demo now on Steam and start your adventure in the [b]Vasrak Kingdom[/b]! 🎮  

Thank you! 🙌
